findings.evidence: Phrase states "A day after trillions evaporated, one AI lab raised $11 billion..." but the BBC stock-plunge article (13:25) and the OpenAI funding articles (21:15–23:46) are all timestamped the same day, 2026-11-06, not a day apart.
findings.suggestion: Change "A day after trillions evaporated" to "Hours after trillions evaporated" or "The same day trillions evaporated" to match the sources' same-day timeline.
